description: Create a new social media post. Can be published immediately or scheduled. Supports Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Google Business, and TikTok. NOTE: For Reddit posts, use the reddit_submit_post tool instead — Reddit is not a CRM-native social provider.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

accountIds.description: Array of social account IDs to post to

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

content.description: Text content of the social media post

locationId.description: Location ID to create the post under

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

mediaUrls.description: Array of media URLs (images/videos) to include in the post

scheduledDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time to schedule the post for future publishing

tags.description: Array of tag strings to categorize the post

name: crm_create_social_post
